decision_rule: Five predeclared interleaved BEP edit pairs, three arms each, one fresh private server per request, greedy sampling. Require canonical fixed BEP verifier PASS, full native counts and two in-request per-PID KFD/loaded HIP samples for each arm. Paired geometric mean prompt-lookup / DFlash2 decode speed >=1.5 is a bounded candidate signal; otherwise no signal. Missing/incomplete/failed evidence is UNKNOWN. NP4 server with one active request; no concurrency throughput or automatic routing proof. Exact native pre-rendered prompt bytes and target-tokenizer repeated-5gram metrics are frozen before publication; no in-grant model hashing or prep. No claim of a 1.5 threshold above a statistical noise floor, only bounded candidate signal.
